sources.quote:
I think neutron generators timing may be bugged, no matter the timing value it appears to be firing the instant the sim starts
FennecFax View Profile View Posts Sep 15 @ 9:25pm Report this post Had the same problem, on 3-1, the first plutonium experiment it changed the detonator times from measuring in MS to PS, changing the timing to the same whole number in PS worked, not sure why it's designed this way #1
Tiax View Profile View Posts Nov 1 @ 5:16am Report this post Same issue there. Even weirder, adding a D-T Neutron Generator pushed the K from 0.98 to 1.04 at rest, even with a 100000 microseconds delay. #2
Rasterz View Profile View Posts Nov 1 @ 5:45am Report this post It's caused by a duplication bug. Delete the DT-generator using air or the select tool, then place a new one. #3
